verdict.rationale: OpenCode is documented as an open-source AI coding agent with a terminal interface. It installs via curl or npm and starts by running `opencode` in any terminal, with a non-interactive `opencode run` mode as well. Community users report using it daily as their primary harness, including with locally run models. Missing for 10: consistent cross-platform terminal reliability (one hands-on report says the TUI would not open on Wayland/Ubuntu 24.04).

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal

citations.quote: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent. It's available as a terminal-based interface, desktop app, or IDE extension.
Just run `opencode` in the terminal to get started.
opencode run "Explain how closures work in JavaScript"
I use it with Qwen 3.5 running locally when my daily limits run out on my other subscriptions. The harness is great.
